en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Zureys,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
that the women have been Given twelve (parts of) desires and twelve (parts of) patience’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Durays who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘
Women are given desires of twelve parts and patience of twelve parts.’”
